meta.source_semantics: Official ClinicalTrials.gov condition/intervention/lead-sponsor search; other filters use snapshot fields.
meta.metric_definition: Number of distinct shared DRUG/BIOLOGICAL identities per sponsor pair; supporting trials are counted separately.
meta.country_policy: A country count includes studies listing any site there. Country filters also restrict country-chart categories. Study-level RECRUITING does not imply each site is recruiting.
meta.phase_policy: Combined phases remain one combined category. Missing phases are Not reported.
meta.date_policy: Year filters always use study start year; time-series x-axis uses the declared time_field. Actual and estimated start dates are included.
meta.enrollment_policy: Missing enrollment excluded; actual/estimated values retained and optionally filtered. Histogram bins are left-closed/right-open; last bin is right-closed.
meta.relationship_limits: Drug co-occurrence means same study, not same arm. Shared-drug sponsor edges indicate shared interventions, not collaboration or ownership.
meta.node_count_scope: Union of supporting trials on displayed edges
meta.sorting: Years ascending; phases in clinical order; other categories by descending total count then label; network edges by descending weight then IDs.
assumptions: Operation: network; grouping: sponsor_shared_drug. Start-year bounds are inclusive.
model_assumptions: Condition and adalimumab filters use official source search semantics, including source synonyms.
Only studies matching both the rheumatoid arthritis and adalimumab searches contribute to the network.
Nodes represent lead sponsors. Links represent shared DRUG or BIOLOGICAL interventions, not sponsor collaboration.
Rank links by the number of distinct shared eligible interventions and include supporting study NCT IDs.
No year restrictions apply; both ACTUAL and ESTIMATED study dates and enrollment are included.
